responsibility: Defines the rs6000 backend’s compile-time default option-spec expansion rules used to turn configure-time defaults such as --with-cpu, --with-tune, --with-float, and default ABI into implicit command-line options. Rather than declaring user-visible options, it builds the driver spec fragments that choose between 32-bit and 64-bit defaults and suppress those defaults when explicit -mcpu, -mtune, -mhard-float, -msoft-float, or ABI options are present.
